Rooftop Cafe · Paharganj, Delhi

Momos, thukpa & mountain air, above Main Bazar.

Everest Kitchen is a rooftop cafe above Main Bazar in Paharganj, Delhi. Tourists and locals come for the momos and thukpa, and stay for the rooftop view over the old city.

About Us

A quiet rooftop over the busiest bazaar in Delhi

Climb up from the chaos of Main Bazar and you find open sky, plastic chairs, and a kitchen that turns out Himalayan comfort food all day — from breakfast momos to late-night thukpa.

LocationMain Bazar, Paharganj, Delhi
SettingRooftop cafe, outdoor seating
Known forMomos, thukpa, ginger lemon honey tea
Rating★ 5.0
